meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 它会把收到的设计(页面、UI截图等)对照 Dieter Rams 十条'好设计'原则逐条打分并给出证据,得出'全新/精修/重新设计'的结论,再生成一段可直接交给 /make-plan 的提示词。它不做编码,只负责评审与交接。
howto.when: 当你说'audit this design'、'design review'、'design audit'等触发词,或要求按 Rams 原则评审设计并导向后续计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个登录界面按 Rams 十原则打分,然后给出精修计划。
say.note: 会生成评分表和 /make-plan 交接提示词。

say.text: audit this design:主页的信息架构,结论是重设计还是精修?
say.note: 会先锁范围,再分派子代理收集证据。

say.text: 按这十个好设计原则评审我的组件库,并产出 redesign 的交接提示。
say.note: 适合已有设计稿但方向存疑的情况。

howto.what_en: Claude scores the submitted design against Dieter Rams' ten principles (0–3, with evidence), returns a verdict (NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN) and a ready-to-run /make-plan handoff prompt. No implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like 'audit this design', 'design review', 'design audit', or a request for a Rams-based critique that should lead to a plan.

say_en.text: Score this login screen against Rams' ten principles and give a refine plan.
Audit this design: home page info architecture—redesign or refine?
say_en.note: Locks scope first, then fans out evidence subagents.

say_en.text: Review my component library by these ten principles and hand off a redesign prompt.
say_en.note: For an existing artifact whose direction is uncertain.
